items.html: After all these scrutinies that were scrutinized during the creation of the worlds ABYA, most of the dross in them had still not been sorted, as the good departs, and the little good remains with the completely evil. Each day, the good is sorted and leaves, and the evil remains. Hence, those parts that were not sorted before the creation of Adam haRishon, and had to be sorted by Mayin Nukvin that Adam would raise through his actions, these were the dross and shells. They were also as it is mentioned in ABYA, since the dross in Atzilut of the shells was made from the better part in them. This, too, is according to the degrees Atik and Arich, etc., and the worst in Beria of the dross, and that, too, according to her degrees etc., and similarly up to Assiya.
